THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
061
STUDY 006
Victorian Library Portrait
Rights check
Source: 4574.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
A moody, period-inspired portrait of an original young
woman standing in a softly blurred library filled with old
leather-bound books and brass objects, cropped from
mid-thigh up and framed vertically. Long, voluminous
light auburn hair falls past her shoulders in soft, defined
curls. She wears a fitted dark velvet jacket with a row of
small buttons down the front and a high lace-trimmed
collar fastened with an ornate brooch. A layered
beaded bracelet sits on one wrist, and her arms are
folded across her body. Her expression is serious and
direct. Warm, soft lighting with gentle falloff into
shadow, a muted palette of deep browns and
burgundy, amber and gold from the wood and
metalwork, and soft rose tones in her skin. Fine grain
and slightly faded color give a vintage film look.
Scholarly, dignified, and quietly intense, in the style of a
historical fiction book cover or Victorian fashion
editorial.
Moody, scholarly, vintage film
WORKING NOTES
- Suited to period drama posters or historical fiction
covers.
- Can be shifted to a different era by changing the
costume.
